chunks: Divorce takes various forms, and none of them is valid except when performed during a period of purity without intercourse, in the presence of two just witnesses, and with the husband willingly intending the divorce without coercion or compulsion.

Among the types of divorce are: the divorce according to the sunnah (prophetic tradition), the divorce of the waiting period, the divorce of an absent husband, the divorce of a minor boy, the divorce of an insane person, the divorce of a woman who has not been consummated, the divorce of a pregnant woman, the divorce of a woman who has not yet reached menstruation, the divorce of a woman who has reached menopause, the divorce of a mute person, and secret divorce.

Other forms include mutual choice, mutual renunciation, disobedience, discord, khulʿ, īlāʾ, ẓihār, liʿān, the divorce of a slave, the divorce of a sick person, the divorce of a missing person, and the terms khaliyyah, bariyyah, battah, bāʾin, harām, as well as the ruling concerning an impotent husband.

key_terms.الطَّلَاقُ: divorce; the dissolution of marriage under specified legal conditions
key_terms.اللِّعَانُ: mutual imprecation between spouses in a case of accusation
key_terms.الْخُلْعُ: divorce initiated in return for compensation given by the wife
key_terms.بِشَاهِدَيْنِ: with two witnesses required for the validity of the divorce
key_terms.حُكْمُ الْعِنِّينِ: the legal ruling concerning an impotent husband
key_terms.طَلَاقُ السُّنَّةِ: a form of divorce carried out in accordance with the sunnah (prophetic tradition)
key_terms.طُهْرٍ: a state of purity in which the woman is not menstruating
key_terms.عَدْلَيْنِ: just and upright; describing the required moral integrity of the witnesses

ai.seo_question: What conditions and types of divorce are recognized in Shia Islamic law?
ai.summary: This text outlines the legal framework of divorce and states the conditions required for a valid divorce, including purity without intercourse, two just witnesses, and the husband's voluntary intent. It then lists many recognized categories and related forms treated within the jurisprudence of divorce in Shia fiqh.
